name: Tokio Aki
source:
[url=/c6258]Ethan[/url]'s Mother. She has a cheerful personality and doesn't focus on difficult problems, but she's a caring mother who always puts her family first. She's said to have disappeared 12 years ago along with her husband [url=/c15885]Timothy[/url].

Aki means "autumn."

[from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Time_Hollow]wikipedia[/url]]
